title: Panelists claiming trade agreements with other planets

tellings.quote: on a a panel with guys I mean who insisted that we have trade agreements with other planets and stuff and we're we're trading back and forth.

plain: A writer named Peter Levenda, whom the episode's title calls a CIA historian, says he once sat on a conference panel with men who insisted that humanity already has trade agreements with other planets, with goods going back and forth. He tells it as something he heard himself, as an example of the kinds of claims he has met on the UFO speaking circuit.
